title: Intel shares jumped 114% in April, hitting a record on April 24 and lifting its market cap past $470B, closing out the chipmaker's best month on record (Katie Tarasov/CNBC)
summary: Katie Tarasov / CNBC: Intel shares jumped 114% in April, hitting a record on April 24 and lifting its market cap past $470B, closing out the chipmaker's best month on record — Intel is on a winning streak unlike any since it became one of the first companies to go public on the Nasdaq nearly 55 years ago.
